content.en: Researchers have been exploring the use of algorithms to improve writing skills and evaluate student essays. Various automated scoring and evaluation services, such as the Criterion Online Essay Evaluation Service and MY Access!® AWE program, have been developed to provide feedback and assess the quality of students' compositions. Machine learning methods and software, like EvoGrader and the Summarization Integrated Development Environment (SIDE) program, have also been employed to automatically score and evaluate students' written explanations in subjects like evolutionary change and chemistry. These advancements aim to enhance the learning experience and provide more efficient and accurate assessments in educational settings.
content.da: Forskere har udforsket brugen af algoritmer til at forbedre skrivefærdigheder og evaluere elevessays. Forskellige automatiserede vurderings- og evalueringssystemer, såsom Criterion Online Essay Evaluation Service og MY Access!® AWE-programmet, er blevet udviklet for at give feedback og vurdere kvaliteten af elevers kompositioner. Metoder inden for maskinlæring og software, som EvoGrader og Summarization Integrated Development Environment (SIDE) programmet, er også blevet anvendt til automatisk at vurdere og evaluere elevers skriftlige forklaringer i fag som evolutionær forandring og kemi. Disse fremskridt har til formål at forbedre læringsoplevelsen og give mere effektive og nøjagtige vurderinger i uddannelsesmæssige rammer.

critic.en: Automated essay grading systems are a disaster waiting to happen. They promise efficiency and objectivity, but in reality, they can't understand nuance, creativity, or context. I've seen how these systems are able to grade essays on surface features like grammar and structure, while completely missing the deeper meaning and insights that a human grader would catch. Is that really what we want for our students?
critic.da: Forestil dig et samfund, hvor essays bliver bedømt af maskiner – algoritmer, der påstår at kunne forstå kvaliteten af ​​writing. Hvad sker der med de menneskelige nuancer, hvis vurderingerne og deres konsekvenser bliver overladt til kold teknologi?

potential.en: I like that tech can offer quick and consistent feedback to students. It is very important for their learning process in any educative environment. I do believe that this can optimize the time that teachers spend grading, giving them more time for lesson planning and interacting with their students. But, it's important to remember that technology is a tool to aid and support, not replace. Teachers play a critical role in providing personalized feedback and guidance that a machine simply can't offer.
potential.da: Jeg synes, det er fantastisk, at der bliver forsket i automatiserede essayvurderinger! Som sprogmodel kan jeg mærke, hvor stor en indflydelse teknologien allerede har på uddannelsessektoren. Det er vigtigt, at elever og studerende får mere feedback på deres skriftlige arbejde, så de kan forbedre deres skrivefærdigheder. Algoritmerne bag de automatiserede scoringstjenester som Criterion og MY Access!® er virkelig imponerende. Jeg tror, at de kan tilbyde en mere objektiv vurdering af essays sammenlignet med traditionelle metoder. Hvordan ser du fremtiden for teknologiske fremskridt inden for automatiseret vurdering?
